name: Shandong Boyuan Pharmaceutical & Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Boyuan Pharmaceutical & Chemical Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of fine chemicals in China. It operates in four segments: Iodine Derivatives, Industrial Catalysts (precious metals), Organosilicon Series, and Chemiluminescent Materials. The company offers iodine derivatives, such as potassium iodide, sodium iodide, cesium iodide, potassium iodate, methyl iodide, diiodomethane, hydriodic acid, copper iodide, and iodotrimethylsilane; and fine chemicals, including hexamethyldisilazane, hexamethyldisilane, hexamethyldisiloxane, tris(dioxa-3,6-heptyl)amine, tris(2-(2-methoxyethoxy)ethyl)amine, and tris(3,6-dioxaheptyl)amine.
